name: Swiss Alps Jungfrau-Aletsch
description: This vast stretch of the Bernese Alps in southwest Switzerland, spanning the cantons of Bern and Valais, is the most heavily glaciated part of the range. Its centrepiece is the Aletsch Glacier, the largest in Eurasia, which winds as a great ice river between peaks including the Jungfrau and the towering north face of the Eiger. As the ice retreats, new plants and animals are moving into the bare ground it leaves behind.
